title: ui: home field read-only with "converted at RATE on DATE"; live preview when a rate exists; Studio editor for `homeAmount` (multi-currency M3-2, epic #8345; the read-only display is released with M2)
body:
Blocked-by: #27191
Blocked-by: #27188

Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Ruling 6465431966 on #27119 (batch #421 item 2, Q1 = 乙-现在, maintainer 「同意立专题卡」 2026-10-28): the multi-currency epic resumes on #8345 in shape C′. Part of #8345. Filed by the director seat (`session_01QSeKYo7qYsX6HsAneHBMP2`, ledger objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a claim. Workload row and precedents: 6464936321; design: 6464438764.

Ruling-ref: 6465431966

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 影子列只读显示并提示「按 X 汇率于 Y 日折算」；有汇率时表单实时预览 ≈ 本位币金额；Studio 字段编辑器加「本位币金额字段」下拉（只列 dynamic 模式存储型币种字段）。
- **为什么改：** 财务对账要看到用了哪条汇率。
- **风险与回滚：** 只读部分随 R2 发布；预览可随 R3。
- **先看：** `fields/src/widgets/CurrencyField.tsx`、app-shell 表单、Studio 字段编辑器。
- **两分钟验证：** 发票表单显示「≈ ¥71,994.24（按 0.1389，2026-11-01）」。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Task

- [ ] Read-only rendering + tooltip from `rateField` / `rateDate`.
- [ ] Preview: one rate read, cached; "awaiting rate" when none.
- [ ] Studio editor.

Lane: ui · Size: M · Review: default. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Epic: #8345 (parent; the epic PM dispatches `pm:epic` children; `domain:spec` children go to the spec seat's queue). Dedupe: #8345 thread, #27119 (ruled), the workload list 6464936321; no open card carries this slice.
